title: Estimado pill without the scheduled prefix
description: Keep the green 'estimado' pill next to the headsign, but drop the '07:50 →' scheduled-time prefix in the eta cell. The live estimate is the number that matters; the superseded timetable time rarely helps a rider and the pill alone already communicates 'live, not scheduled'.
baseline_ref: app/components/ArrivalRow.vue renders both .arrival-row__badge--estimated (pill) and .arrival-row__scheduled ('HH:mm →' prefix) on estimated rows today

changes.intent: Stop rendering the scheduled clock prefix entirely, keeping only the estimado badge as the provenance signal.
changes.detail: Remove the .arrival-row__scheduled span from the template (the v-if="scheduledTimeDisplay" block inside .arrival-row__eta). The scheduledTimeDisplay computed and .arrival-row__scheduled CSS become dead and can be deleted. The .arrival-row__badge--estimated pill is untouched.
